# Bipartite_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network topology where nodes are partitioned into two disjoint sets, with connections only between sets, not within each set. Bipartite structures can enhance robustness in evolving systems, offering a design principle for resilient interconnect architectures in TCC.
